rule: Baselines are read from the committed line-census and T-0164 scope-baseline files at these revisions. Targets are fixed by T-0165 and cannot be moved to explain a miss. Protected, historical, generated, operational and tooling-ledger scopes are reported but never reduction targets.

rows.rationale: A fixed 2,141-line net reduction goal across named route, data, client and component work; new-interface costs are not yet measured and the overlapping 12,800-line estimate is excluded.
A fixed 1,754-line net reduction goal from shared fixtures and narrow source-text replacements; behavioural oracle cost is unknown and test names and floors take priority.
A fixed 62-line window reduction goal from hook return/consumer restatement and route envelopes; two-consumer folds require measured net benefit.
A fixed 186-line window reduction goal from shared fixtures and request mocks with three or more consumers; no subject-only suite merge or assertion loss is allowed.
A fixed four-component reduction goal among 104 one-importer components; candidates are selected only after accessibility and net-cost checks, so no four are claimed dead today.
A fixed 525-line net goal; the ruled bench-gateway files contain 179 lines, while wrapper and replacement-oracle costs remain to be measured and public CLI names stay.
A fixed 264-line live-doc goal from duplicate root and running guidance; five ruled generated extractors are tooling scope and do not count toward this row.
A fixed 25-line live-org goal from duplicate handover and process text; protected, historical and derived material is excluded and new evidence may offset reductions.

closing: For every row, report baseline, target, final count and delta. Any miss is named individually with its measured number and reason; the original five historical commitments are reported separately. A favourable aggregate cannot conceal a row miss.
